deliverable: Deliverable 4 — Compliance Eligibility and BRL Settlement Orchestration Testnet

criteria.text: Public interface schemas and anonymized fixtures demonstrate that normalized verification states control offering access.
Testnet transaction links and redacted reconciliation exports join BRL deposit/withdrawal records to terminal Stellar states.
Public CI covers failed, expired, rejected, refunded, duplicate, and retried operations without state loss.
The public evidence index demonstrates that no PII is written to the published Stellar transactions or contract events.
